title: A command name or option spelling that a command line cannot type compiles.
text: `#[Core\Command(name: "")]` and `name: "do it"` compile, and so do `#[Core\Option(short: "ab")]`, `short: "-"` and `long: ""`. A name with a space can never be the first word of a command line, and an empty name can never be typed. `short: "-"` and `long: ""` are both spelled `--`, so two such options are `E0745` with that spelling. `rule:tooling/commands-are-compiled` calls `short:` the one-letter spelling. It closes when a name or a `long:` that is empty or has a space, and a `short:` that is not one letter or digit, are checker errors with a conformance case.
